summary: ELLIE AS (org. no. 914 868 378) is a private limited company (AS) based in Oslo, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2015-01-27. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 68.200 (Utleie av egen eller leid fast eiendom); it has 0 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 54 101 and net income was -NOK 10 629. CEO: Fredrik Bergaplass; board chair: Fredrik Bergaplass; auditor: ØSTLANDSKE REVISORER AS. Also: LEI 25490081U6F6L3OPHB97.
